concerns.text: T025a hard-fails with ValueError if 'is_paired' is false, explicitly forbidding fallback to Permutation/Z-test. This violates FR-005 and Plan.md which mandate handling non-deterministic diverging trajectories via alternative statistical methods rather than aborting the pipeline.

T025a asserts 'is_paired' must be true and raises ValueError, preventing the generation of statistical artifacts (mcnemar_results.json, ttest_results.json) required by T057b/c. This creates a logical dead-end where the pipeline cannot produce the final report if trajectories diverge, violating the requirement to handle divergence.

T054 (Phase 6) mandates excluding mismatched trajectories to save the paired test, but T025a (Phase 4) runs earlier and aborts the entire pipeline on the first mismatch. The dependency order prevents the exclusion logic from ever executing, rendering the divergence handling mechanism non-functional.

FR-001 requires training on 'ground-truth memory layer utility' derived from ablation. T008/T008c output JSON files, but there is no explicit task to convert these into the structured 'utility_delta' per layer required by T009 (classifier training). This risks a data format mismatch where the classifier cannot consume the ground truth.

T056 requires generating 'token_budget_detailed.csv' with columns 'layers_pruned' and 'pruning_reason'. However, T015c (the implementing task) only describes 'pruning least useful layers' without defining the logging logic or output schema. The task description fails to preserve the acceptance criterion of verifiable pruning data.
